description: This file defines the Service class within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace, including its nested Config class. It declares the interface for a plugin service, including configuration management, web server enabling/disabling, state handling, and metadata retrieval. The class is designed to be inherited and used as part of a plugin system, with various methods for managing plugin lifecycle and interactions.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service with lifecycle management, configuration, web server hosting, and metadata capabilities within the WPEFramework plugin system.

methods.name: Versions
methods.description: Returns the supported versions of the plugin.

methods.name: Locator
methods.description: Returns the locator string of the plugin.

methods.name: ClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the plugin.

methods.name: Callsign
methods.description: Returns the callsign identifier of the plugin.

methods.name: WebPrefix
methods.description: Returns the web prefix URL for the plugin.

methods.name: ConfigLine
methods.description: Returns the current configuration line as a string.

methods.name: ConfigLine (setter)
methods.description: Sets a new configuration line if the plugin is in a deactivated or unavailable state.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Returns the persistent storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Returns the volatile storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Returns the data storage path for the plugin.

methods.name: SystemRootPath
methods.description: Returns the system root path configured for the plugin.

methods.name: SystemRootPath (setter)
methods.description: Sets the system root path for the plugin.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the plugin.

methods.name: Resumed
methods.description: Indicates whether the plugin is resumed.

methods.name: Resumed (setter)
methods.description: Sets the resumed state of the plugin.

methods.name: Startup
methods.description: Returns the startup mode of the plugin.

methods.name: Startup (setter)
methods.description: Sets the startup mode of the plugin.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given version number is supported.

methods.name: EnableWebServer
methods.description: Enables web server hosting for the plugin at a specified URL path.

methods.name: DisableWebServer
methods.description: Disables web server hosting for the plugin.

methods.name: GetMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the plugin.

methods.name: IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Checks if a request segment is for the web server.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to subscribers.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound JSON elements, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: FileToServe
methods.description: Serves a file over HTTP based on a web service request.
